descr.name: A screen to identify the genes that modify the response of osteosarcoma to doxorubicin in mouse - Primary Screen
description: Genome wide protein coding siRNA screen to identify synthetic lethal interactions with doxorubicin in mouse primary osteosarcoma cells
protocol: The transfection is performed in quadruplicate in 384 well plates labelled A, B, C and D. This gives duplicates for without drug (plates A and B) and with Doxorubicin (plates C and D)

The mouse siRNA library (Dharmacon GE) consists of 16,817 individual protein coding genes consisting of the following gene families: Protein kinases (G-003505), GPCR (G-003605), Phosphatases (G-003705), Ion channel (G-003805), Drug targets (G-004655), Remaining genome (G005005).
siRNA - 21 bp chemically synthesized sequences, arrayed format (384 well plates, diluted in 1x siRNA buffer (Dharmacon GE source).
Unique siRNA molecules per reagent pool:

SMARTpool siRNAs (Dharmacon RNAi Technologies). 4 individual siRNAs targeting each gene, pooled together in one well. Ideally, the 4 sequences will target all isoforms/transcript variants of a gene and they are generally in the coding region.
400 cells per well were plated in a 384 well plate
doxorubicin, 100nM added 48 hours after plating/transfection and left for a further 72hrs prior to assay measurement with Cell TitreGlo. IC30-40.
Dharmacon RNAi Technologies for siRNA. Promega for Cell Titer Glo.
Celltiter-Glo luminescent assay- end point assay for viability that measures ATP in the cell.

All siRNA and lipid/opti-MEM complexing is performed in 1 plate (A plate) and subsequently transferred to assay plates B, C and D.  6ul siRNA (1uM stock) is added to 44ul lipid:opti-MEM mix, mixed and complexed for 20 minutes in plate A. Then 12.5ul is transferred to plates B, C and D.  Final concentration of SMARTpool is 40 nM. All liquid handling steps performing using a Calliper Sciclone ALH3000 liquid handling robot. Cells were reverse transfected by adding 25ul of cells (400cells) per wellto the pre-mixed siRNA/lipid complex using a Biotek 406 (Biotek) dispense workstation.
400 cells per well were plated in a 384 well plate
siRNA is added to pre-diluted lipid in opti-MEM, mixed and complexed for 20 minutes.
White walled, clear bottom 384-well plate. Tissue-culture treated polystyrene, flat bottom, with lid.
